docfloat.allocation_ownership_contract: Each allocation region reports boundary-relative allocations. The opened Editor is retained from open through replace_and_validate; the staged Editor is retained until finish; the returned Vec is retained across finish. Format output is also retained outside its region for validation. retained_bytes is live ownership at the region boundary, not RSS.
